data.notes: The report gets the most important points right. It scopes the win to online membership billing with the front desk still on Global. It surfaces the Maya-chose/Greg-decided contradiction, flags the hedged 'third of the churn' as opinion, and leads messaging with own-file recovery proof while dropping 'unified commerce.' It has three weaknesses. The trigger section omits the 'members who never meant to leave' quote as evidence. The close wrongly lists the decider question as 'dodged' and frames the takeaway as honest scope reporting rather than treating the front desk as a live deal. Two excerpts are attributed to the wrong speaker: the termination-fee line is credited to Greg and the rep's paraphrase to Maya.
